# GIMP MCP Server (v4.6.0)

Professional image editing through GIMP 3 — controlled by AI agents via the Model Context Protocol.
18 portmanteau tools consolidating ~1000 GIMP PDB procedures.

## Tools
| Tool | Ops | Description |
|------|-----|-------------|
| `gimp_file` | 6 | load, save, convert, info, validate, list_formats |
| `gimp_transform` | 7 | resize, crop, rotate, flip, scale, perspective, autocrop |
| `gimp_color` | 12 | brightness, contrast, levels, curves, HSL, balance, auto, invert |
| `gimp_filter` | 8 | blur, sharpen, noise, edge_detect, artistic, enhance, distort |
| `gimp_layer` | 8 | create, duplicate, merge, flatten, opacity, blend, reorder, info |
| `gimp_analysis` | 8 | quality, statistics, histogram, compare, detect_issues, report |
| `gimp_batch` | 6 | resize, convert, process, watermark, rename, optimize |
| `gimp_system` | 8 | status, help, diagnostics, cache, config, performance, tools, version |
| `gimp_pdb` | ∞ | Universal PDB proxy — call any of ~1000+ GIMP procedures |
| `gimp_workspace` | 10 | list images, undo/redo, undo groups, metadata, resolution |
| `gimp_channel` | 8 | create, delete, list, set color/opacity, duplicate channels |
| `gimp_animation` | 5 | list frames, set delay, optimize/export GIF |
| `gimp_paths` | 8 | create, delete, stroke, import/export SVG, vector paths |
| `gimp_parasites` | 9 | XCF metadata: list, attach, detach parasites |
| `gimp_gmic` | 4 | G'MIC filter integration — 500+ filters |
| `gimp_gegl` | 2 | GEGL non-destructive editing |
| `gimp_color_management` | 7 | ICC profiles, assignment, conversion, soft proofing |
| `gimp_snapshot` | 1+ | **get_state_snapshot** — live base64 PNG, region crop, AI vision loop |

## Quick Start
```
git clone https://github.com/sandraschi/gimp-mcp
cd gimp-mcp
uv sync
uv run python -m gimp_mcp.main    # stdio (Claude Desktop)
# Set MCP_PORT=10773 for SSE mode
```
